releaseNotes:
v1.0.1-preview.31
- Synchronized package version with the preview.31 release.

v1.0.1-preview.30
- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.30, which fixes offline ServerAndCache reads so they fall back to the cache, maps gRPC call-creation failures to FirestoreErrorCode.Unavailable, makes cached timestamp filters match server-cached Timestamp values at Firestore native precision, and fixes Timestamp.FromDateTime/FromDateTimeOffset throwing for pre-1970 instants. Persisted field indexes from earlier previews are rebuilt automatically on open; no manual migration is required. BREAKING: the parameterless WithConverter<TModel>() is removed; use Collection<T>()/Document<T>() for JSON auto-conversion or WithConverter with a converter/delegates. Custom model conversion now runs through internal document codecs on native references and queries (the Converted* wrapper hierarchy is retired), and IDocumentSnapshot<T>.TryGet(field, out value) distinguishes an absent field from a stored null.

v1.0.1-preview.29
- Synchronized package version with the preview.29 release.

v1.0.1-preview.28
- Synchronized package version with the preview.28 release.

v1.0.1-preview.27
- The loopback emulator defaults (localhost and 127.0.0.1) now resolve to 10.0.2.2 automatically on Android at service registration (FirebaseEmulatorHosts.Resolve in Core), so the default configuration works inside an AVD with no Android-specific code. Mirrors the official Flutter SDK's automaticHostMapping. Every other host is respected verbatim; set AutomaticHostMapping = false on the builder to keep loopback addresses verbatim, e.g. for adb reverse setups.

- Updated to depend on FireForNet.Firebase.Firestore 1.0.1-preview.13, which adds offline-first optimistic writes (opt-in via FirestoreBuilder.OptimisticWrites) and eliminates the proto-to-JSON round-trip on typed model conversion. Offline writes persist via the SQLite backend.
